versions.changelog:
Initial release: Generate a full week of platform-optimized social media content from a single topic.

- Automatically creates 7 days of posts for Twitter, Instagram, and LinkedIn
- Produces a JSON export for scheduling tools and a color-coded, print-friendly HTML content calendar
- Provides hashtag suggestions, best posting times, and engagement hooks for each platform
- CLI supports topic/brand input, platform selection, custom durations, and input via stdin
- Content mix follows the 70-20-10 educational/promotional/engaging rule
